authority_contract.handoff: Build Classifier Prompt returns domainFacts explicitly; Validate Classifier Output consumes source.domainFacts

publish_gate.draft_write: Apply only write_call as one atomic three-operation draft update after the immediately-before-write version and full-graph gate passes.
publish_gate.review: Re-fetch and validate the complete draft; require exactly the three approved parameter deltas and no topology, connection, credential-reference, trigger, disabled-state, settings, or activation delta. Also run draft_rollback.validate_only_call_after_forward_draft successfully before publish, so the pre-publish escape path is proven against the actual patched draft.
publish_gate.post_publish: In n8n 2.33 activateWorkflow is the separate publish step. Re-fetch mode=active and require active=true and the published graph to equal the reviewed draft. Do not manually trigger or execute the workflow.

safety_note: Prepared and validateOnly-checked only. Before any live write, re-fetch full and active workflow and require the exact prepared_against version/activation plus a complete graph match. Apply the three parameter patches atomically with continueOnError=false. Re-fetch and full-diff the draft, validate the standalone reverse call against that patched draft, then use the separate activateWorkflow publish operation. If the draft gate fails, atomically reverse the three fields and require the captured active prestate. Do not execute, send, or change credentials.

draft_rollback.scope: Use only after the approved three-operation draft write and before publish if the complete draft diff or validation gate fails. The active published graph remains the captured prestate until the separate publish step.

prepared_roundtrip_validate_only_result.message: Validation successful. Operations are valid but not applied.

The six-operation forward-plus-reverse validateOnly proves the strict reverse operations sequentially without mutation. After a real forward draft write, run the standalone three-operation reverse validateOnly before any publish; if rollback is needed, apply it atomically and require the complete draft to equal the captured active prestate.
